items.title: 67250_John Collins oral history interview
items.q: I was working with Zuty and all of the-- the real jazz men.

ctx.x: He also taught I think this guy's name is Albert Pick, who was -- he's quite a guitarist, he's quite a classical

guitarist. And he lives in Chicago, but at this time that he was teaching Pick he was trying to get me to take classical guitar. But I was working with Roy at the time, at the Three Duces, and I wasn't interested. You know, I was thinking of jazz then you know. I was working with Zuty and all of the-- the real jazz men. And that was -- I just went to him, for musicianship, really, you know.
Frank Lanham, a great teacher. He died -- he used to come down to hear me play.
